title: Four source-conditioned benchmark-DRAFT blind adjudication items

output_contract.status: Primary four-item task status; success is independent of optional human review
output_contract.item_bank: Original four-item bank with agent-derived reference answers and 0/1/2 rubrics
output_contract.adjudication: Optional independent verdicts/disputes, or typed not_applicable when no actual human verdicts exist
output_contract.agreement: Optional automatic-final comparison, or typed not_applicable with no human kappa
output_contract.raw_agreements: Per-item automatic/final labels without imputation, or explicit not-applicable rows
output_contract.failures: Searchable mismatch failure records; empty when no comparison was conducted
output_contract.targeted_probes: Next-version probe specifications with retest item IDs; empty when no comparison was conducted
output_contract.sources: Supplied source excerpts and exact locators
output_contract.uncertainty: Source provenance, review availability, unresolved, and support limitations
output_contract.change_records: Stage-by-stage transformations, primary status, and optional-review limitations
output_contract.summary: Primary completion counts and separate optional-review status
output_contract.diagnostics: Machine-readable separation of primary item-bank completion and optional review
